newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope to visit Sarajevo on April 13.
newsitem.headline: Pope to visit Sarajevo on April 13.

text.p: Pope John Paul will make his long-awaited trip to Sarajevo on April 13, the Vatican said on Thursday.
The Pope had to cancel a trip to the Bosnian capital in September 1994 while the city was engulfed in warfare, for security reasons.

A Vatican statement said the Pope was making the visit "above all to encourage the Catholic community in Bosnia-Herzegovina to carry on its active Christian witness in every part of the country and to promote understanding and cooperation with the members of all religious confessions".

The Vatican said the Pope hoped that his visit, his first overseas trip this year, would help "efforts being made to build a just peace and to restore a full and harmonious civil life in that country".

Religion underlies the conflict which has torn apart Bosnia, a united region under former Yugoslavia, now largely divided into separate communities of Orthodox Serbs, Roman Catholic Croats and Moslems.
